slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
It's been three months since Mr Turtle made it to the gym. Only his membership is getting a workout.

Exercise snacks are short bursts of strength work, a few minutes at a time, sprinkled through your day. Research suggests these small bouts add up and can build strength over time, and Australia's guidelines recommend muscle strengthening on at least two days a week.

Try 10 squats while the kettle boils, stairs, calf raises while brushing, or a 60-second plank before bed. Make the last few reps moderately hard.

Managing a niggle? Start with one or two a day. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can build a short routine around your schedule. Book online via the link in bio.
